names.name: coord_scale_interp_pair_store
names.comment: 坐标线性插值映射: 全局 flag 为 0 时直接 strh r2/r3, 否则按 [g+0x10]/[g+0xc] 比例插值后写 [r0]/[r1] 半字

names.name: call_03ee2c_fallback_03f1dc
names.comment: 先 bl 0x0203ee2c(r0,r1,[pc+0x28],sp), 失败(返回0)则 bl 0x0203f1dc 兜底, 读 [sp] 返回

names.name: spin_wait_global_not_1
names.comment: 忙等循环: ldr [g] == 1 时死循环, 直到全局 != 1 才 bx lr

names.name: tail_call_03b9b8_const_0x12
names.comment: thunk: r0=0x12, bx ip->0x0203b9b8

names.name: global_flag_once_set_1
names.comment: 全局 [g] != 1 时置 1 (once-only 初始化 guard)

names.name: grid_index_rowstride_0x38_addr
names.comment: 网格二维索引→线性地址: r0 = y*0x38 + (x+1)*4 + y*4*3 + y*8 + (x+1)*2*2 + y*2 (row stride 0x38)

names.name: tail_call_03bbb0
names.comment: thunk: bx ip->0x0203bbb0, 参数透传

names.name: tail_call_03c5b8
names.comment: thunk: bx ip->0x0203c5b8, 参数透传

names.name: grid_bufsize_calc_max_field30
names.comment: r0=max(r0,[r2+0x30]); 返回 4*(3*r0^2 + (r0+1)^2) — 网格 buffer 大小计算

names.name: node_counter_inc_finalize_call_39f4c
names.comment: [r5+0xc] 计数++, [*r5]=0 清首节点, 然后 bl 0x02039f4c 完成回调

names.name: call_seq_bc90_be9c_e_clear_global
names.comment: bl 0x0203bc90 + bl 0x0203be9c(0xe, [pc+0x1c]) + 清全局 word=0

names.name: tail_call_0408cc_r1_1
names.comment: thunk: r1=1, bx ip->0x020408cc

names.name: state_byte_1524_check_ret_0x15
names.comment: 读 [g+0x1524] byte, 为 0 则返回 0x15; 非 0 继续读 [g+0x1525]+1 移位处理

names.name: count_halfword_array_until_zero
names.comment: 遍历半字数组 (post-index ldrh), 统计到 0 终止的元素个数

names.name: global_halfword_6_store
names.comment: strh r0, [g, #6] — 全局对象偏移 6 半字 setter

names.name: tail_call_0367ec_zero_0x70
names.comment: thunk: r1=0, r2=0x70 (清零大小), bx ip->0x020367ec (memset 型)

names.name: query_flag_0x1d_0x40_cond
names.comment: bl 0x10feb38(0x1d, 1, &out); out==0xff 返回 0, 否则 (out & 0x40) ? 1 : 0

names.name: tail_epilogue_after_node_init
names.comment: 函数尾部 epilogue: add sp, pop {r4,r5,lr}, bx lr (属于节点初始化函数尾部)
